adaptation: Original dark palettes are preserved in variants.dark; Rinx-authored light counterparts are in variants.light. Palette selection preserves Light/Dark/System mode.
Source alt is the panel/incoming bubble; accent_tint is the outgoing bubble/selected state.
Source contrast-tuned accent_text is Rinx primary action, which also styles text links.
Source text inks are retained; warning uses highlight on surface. Platform fonts, dimensions and icons remain inherited.
Light variants use opaque coordinated page, white/cream incoming bubbles and tinted outgoing bubbles with >=4.5:1 primary/secondary text contrast and >=1.15:1 separation between chat fills.
